semantics.destination_rule: Each mapping entry references an exact destination schema/field identity.
semantics.name_rule: Matching field names never imply a mapping.

semantics.constant_rule: Constants/default values are explicit mapping entries with provenance.
semantics.missing_rule: Missing source field behavior is explicit: fail, default, omit or other declared action.
semantics.extra_rule: Unmapped source fields are explicitly ignored/rejected/preserved according to profile.
